games_to_watch.rooting_note: Duke would need to pull off an upset.
Duke is favored to beat Clemson.

routes.condition: Duke wins all of its next 2 games
routes.headline: Root for Duke.
routes.story: Mark gets a better shot if Duke wins all of its next 2 games.
routes.why: Mark picked Duke to beat its preseason win target. Wins are good news for that pick.
routes.difficulty: Needs a few things to break right
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 23 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.narrative: Mark does not need style points from Duke. A messy win does the same job for this pick as a blowout. Survive first; look impressive later. This particular route asks for a clean sweep; one wrong result breaks the streak, though other paths remain.
routes.banter: If Duke struggles, Mark may hear the word toast more than he would like. Occupational hazards now include the group chat.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Mark has a stronger title case and a ready-made reason to remind everyone about this pick.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
